sources.title: $Z^*$: Zero-shot Style Transfer via Attention Rearrangement
sources.snippet: Despite the remarkable progress in image style transfer, formulating style in the context of art is inherently subjective and challenging. In contrast to existing learning/tuning methods, this study shows that vanilla diffusion models can directly extract style information and seamlessly integrate the generative prior into the content image without retraining.
